fully_funded_only.label: Fully funded only
fully_funded_only.description: Keep only opportunities that cover tuition and living costs, or a stipend, as stated by the provider.

open_deadlines_only.label: Open deadlines only
open_deadlines_only.description: Remove opportunities whose current deadline has passed.

strict_verification.label: Strict source verification
strict_verification.description: Include only opportunities whose deadline and eligibility are confirmed on an official page.

include_application_fees.label: Include programmes with application fees
include_application_fees.description: Keep programmes that charge an application fee, clearly flagged. Pay to apply schemes from non official sources stay excluded.

include_rolling_deadlines.label: Include rolling deadlines
include_rolling_deadlines.description: Keep opportunities that accept applications all year.

balanced_mix.label: Balanced reach, target, and safe mix
balanced_mix.description: Aim for a spread of reach, target, and safe options in the final list.
